entry.title: [BIP Draft] Co-signer Spending Policies
entry.summary:
A recent update has been made to the draft version 2.1 of the cosigner spending policies proposal. The latest revision introduces several significant enhancements, including strict verifier semantics, support for versioned commitments, and mechanisms ensuring signed finality. Additionally, a correction has been applied to the k-of-n aspect, along with improvements to citation references and updates to section headers.
The full schema, precise byte vectors, and a comprehensive reference implementation are still under development and have not yet been completed. The draft remains open for feedback from the community, and contributors are encouraged to share their thoughts either through the designated mailing list or by commenting on the project's [GitHub repository](https://github.com/lukecarriere/bip-cosigner-spending-policies/commit/c21ed45c1eb78a562962d17a5fdaa86c9d7befb3).
Further details regarding the progression of this proposal can be found in the original post dated October 5, accessible via the [Bitcoindev Google Group](https://groups.google.com/g/bitcoindev/c/yoL5VVMO4Qg). These ongoing efforts reflect a commitment to robust discussion and iterative improvement within the developer community.
